desc.en: The Cultural & Museum Centre Karonga (CMCK), commonly called Karonga Museum, is a cultural centre and museum in Karonga District, northern Malawi.
desc.es: El Museo Karonga es un centro cultural y museo del distrito de Karonga, al norte de Malawi.
